text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Mejiro Dober—
there was quite a commotion in front of the shopping mall.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Is that... Air Groove-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I'm honored you'd even shake my hand...!
Thank you so, so much!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I was watching your last race from the front row...!
Your performance truly lived up to the name "Empress"...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for your support.
It has been a great encouragement.
I will continue to work hard to live up to your expectations.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
T-That's wonderful...!
Could I please shake your hand next...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Great work out there, Air Groove-senpai.
There were so many fans watching.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I am grateful to receive such recognition.
It straightens my posture with the resolve that I must keep aiming higher
to repay all the support I've been given.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...You really are amazing after all, Senpai.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If it were me, I'm sure—I couldn't show
such a confident, dignified side to my fans.
choice_data_list: There's no need to put yourself down like that.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Given your circumstances, it can't be helped.
Besides, I understand feeling nervous in front of a crowd.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, don't lose sight of the essence.
What matters is what you want to do—
that is all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What do I want to do...?

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text: Ah! It's Mejiro Dober! She's just as amazing in person~!!

text_block_list.name: Fan E
text_block_list.text:
You've really been the talk of the town lately!
I've become a huge fan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
M-Me...!?
Not Air Groove-senpai... !?
choice_data_list: Because you're a charming Uma Musume too.
Because you're a charming Umamusume too, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
S-Shut up!
Don't say things just to confuse me more……!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Don't praise me too, Trainer...!
It's only making me more confused...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Dober.
How did you feel about those people
who acknowledged your hard work and cheered you on?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Dober.
How did you feel about those people
who acknowledged your hard work and cheered you on?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, I'm happy you're cheering for me.
And I really want to thank you properly, but..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Even so, I just can't be like you, Senior—
choice_data_list: Just express the gratitude you're able to give right now.
Just convey the gratitude you can right now.
I'll be cheering you on with all I've got!
I'll cheer you on with all I've got!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Even so, I just can't be like you, Senior—
choice_data_list: Just express the gratitude you're able to give right now.
Just convey the gratitude you can right now.
I'll be cheering you on with all I've got!
I'll cheer you on with all I've got!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Can we do it now...?
choice_data_list: You don't have to aim for perfection right off the bat.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Right. What they're looking for
are heartfelt words that only Dober could give."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Air Groove-senpai...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As long as you take it one step at a time, you'll eventually reach
the ideal vision both I and you are aiming for.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I'll... do it.
Because I've decided... to grow stronger than I am now...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: U-Um... Everyone, my fans...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Even if you cheer for me, I...
choice_data_list: You'll be able to hold your head high in front of your dad, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I appreciate the thought, but...
choice_data_list: You'll be able to hold your head high in front of your dad, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Before...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph.
I was planning to do that even without you telling me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah. It's a chance to grow,
and I don't want to have any regrets..."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'm cheering for you too, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'm cheering for you too, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As long as you take it one step at a time, you'll eventually reach
the ideal vision both I and you are aiming for.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: U-Um... Everyone, my fans...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Compared to other Umamusume, I've still got a long way to go, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep doing my best...!
And also, um...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for cheering me on...!
I'm so, so happy...!

text_block_list.name: Fan E
text_block_list.text:
...T-The pleasure is mine!
Please keep doing your best from now on as well!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh.
Seems there was no need for concern after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …………Whatever.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Do you really think so...? Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"I'm changing, aren't I?
Little by little... I'm sure of it."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though Mejiro Dober put on a cold demeanor,
her expression somehow looked quite radiant.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Mejiro Dober gave her thanks,
her expression seemed somehow brighter.
